Question
========
Rawls's difference principle states that inequalities are acceptable only if they ...

Answerlist
----------
* benefit the least advantaged
* result from hard work
* are below a Gini of 0.3
* are approved by a majority vote

Solution
========
Behind the veil of ignorance, Rawls argues, people would accept inequalities only if they work to the benefit of the least well-off.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
